simple.meaning: to visit (with friendly or hostile intent); by analogy, to oversee , muster , charge , care for , miss , deposit , etc.
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to פָּקַד (H6485) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 304 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: פָּקַד (pâqad) means to visit (with friendly or hostile intent); by analogy, to oversee , muster , charge , care for , miss , deposit , etc. First listed occurrence: 1Chr 21 6.

definitions.full: H6485. paqad מָּקַד 303 verb attend to, visit, muster, appoint (Late Hebrew id., visit, enjoin ; Phoenician פקד attend to, provide ; Assyrian pa‡âdu = Biblical Hebrew; Arabic lose, miss ; also (Dozy) give heed, attention, to ; Ethiopic visit, muster, desire, need , etc.; Nabataean פקד command (Cook), so מְּקַד ᵑ7 Pa`el, Syriac , also visit ); — Qal 234 Perfect 3masculine singular ׳פ Exod 4:31 +; 1 singular מָּקַדְתִּי 3:16 +, etc.; Imperfect 3masculine singular יִפְקֹד Gen 50:24 +, etc.; Imperative masculine singular מְּקֹד Num 3:15 +, etc.; Infinitive absolute מָּקֹד Gen 50:24 +; construct לִפְקֹד 2Sam 24:4 +, etc.; Participle active מֹּקֵד Exod 20:5 +; passive מְּקֻדִים (הַ) 30:14 +, construct מְּקוּדֵי Num 31:14 +, etc.; — A. 1. a. pay attention to, observe (with care, practical interest), of ׳י with accusative of person + of thing Exod 3:16 (J), with accusative of person 4:31 (J; || רָאָה ), Psa 8:5 (with providence, compare מְּקֻדָּה Job 10:12 ; || זָכַר ); with accusative of thing 1Sam 15:2 ; Psa 80:15 (|| רָאָה הִבִּיט, ), Lam 4:22 (|| עַל גִּלָּה ), חַטאֹתָם וְיִפְקֹד עֲוֺנָם יִוְכֹּר Hosea 8:13 = 9:9 = Jer 14:10 ; 1Sam 17:18 observe thy brothers as to well-being ( לְשָׁלוֺם ; i.e. see how they fare). b. attend to , in act, see to , with accusative of person 2Kin 9:34 ; accusative of sheep Jer 23:2 (in figurative); compare Zech 10:3 ; b 11:16 . c. seek (with interest, desire), seek ׳י Isa 26:16 ; in bad sense, look about for Ezek 23:21 . Hence d. seek in vain, need, miss, lack (compare Niph`al , and Arabic Ethiopic above), with accusative of person 1Sam 20:6 ; Isa 34:16 , of thing 1Sam 25:15 ; Jer 3:16 . 2 specifically visit , with accusative, for different purposes: with ( ב ) a present Judg 15:1 ; especially of ׳י , visit graciously Gen 21:1 ; 50:24-25 , = Exod 13:19 (all E), Isa 23:17 ; Jer 15:15 (|| זָכַר ), 27:22 ; 29:10 ; Psa 65:10 +; בִּישׁוּעָתֶ֑ךָ 106:4 (|| זָכַר ); visit to search, test, accusative of person Job 7:18 (|| כָּחַן ), Psa 17:3 (|| id. ; object omitted), absolute Job 31:14 ; to punish Jer 6:15 ; 49:8 ; 50:31 ; Psa 59:6 ; accusative of person omitted Exod 32:34 a Isa 26:14 , with עַל of thing (of sin) Jer 5:9 , 29 ; 9:8 (here + ב person); accusative of thing Psa 89:33 ; absolute, of ׳י s anger Job 35:15 . 3 with עַל person, visit upon , ׳י subject, + accusative of thing (of sin) Amos 3:2 , 14 ; Hosea 1:4 ; 2:15 ; Exod 20:5 ; 34:7 ; Deut 5:9-10 t.; accusative of thing omitted, = punish Isa 10:12 ; Jer 9:24 ; 11:22 ; 13:21 10 t. Jeremiah, + 8 t.; + כ of thing Hosea 12:3 ; Jer 21:14 ; + clause of sin Hosea 4:14 ; with אֶל person Jer 50:18 (twice in verse), אֶל + עַל 46:18 ; indefinite subject with עַל of vineyard = injure Isa 27:3 . 4 pass in review, muster (nearly = number ), with accusative, 1Sam 11:8 ; 13:15 ; 2Sam 24:2 , 4 11 t. + Num 1:3 , 19 , 44 , 49 16 t. Numbers (P); accusative omitted 1Sam 14:17 (twice in verse); Num 3:42 ; object נָוֶה Job 5:24 ; especially passive participle, persons or things mustered (numbered) , Exod 30:12-13 , 14 ; 38:25-26 , Num 1:21-22 , 67t. Numbers; + 1Chr 23:24 . B. appoint: 1 with accusative of person + אִתָּם Gen 40:4 , + עַל person over whom Jer 15:3 ; 51:27 ; Num 27:16 , + אֶל (for עַל ) Jer 49:19 = 50:44 ; with accusative of person alone Num 3:10 , + הָעָם בְּראֹשׁ Deut 20:9 ; passive participle plural appointed ones, officers , of (fighting) host Num 31:14 , 48 ; 2Kin 11:15 ; 2Chr 23:14 . 2 with accusative of thing, appoint, assign , + עַל person to whom, Num 4:27 (on text see Di); with accusative of thing only, 4:32 ; compare Job 34:13 ; 36:23 ; lay upon ( עַל person) as a charge , Zeph 3:7 (reading ᵐ5 מֵעֵינֶיהָ, We Now, for מְעוֺנָהּ ); + infinitive 2Chr 36:23 = Ezra 1:2 ; = deposit , with accusative of thing + ב location, 2Kin 5:24 (compare מִּקָּדוֺן ). Niph`al Perfect 3masculine singular נִפְקַד 1Sam 25:7 +; 2 masculine singular וְנִפְקַדְתָּ֫ 20:18 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular יִמָּקֵד 20:18 +, etc.; Infinitive הִמָּקֵד absolute 1Kin 20:39 ; construct Judg 21:3 ; — 1 be ( sought , i.e. needed ) missed, lacking 1Sam 20:18 + 20:19 ( ᵐ5 , for תֵּרֵד ᵑ0 , We Dr and others), 25:7 ; 1Kin 20:39 (+ infinitive absolute), 2Kin 10:19 (twice in verse); Jer 23:4 (Gr Gie conjecture יִפְחָ֖דוּ ), + מִן particle Judg 21:3 ; 1Sam 25:21 ; 2Sam 2:30 ; Num 31:49 ; of seat 1Sam 20:18 , place 20:25 ; 20:27 (i.e. be empty ). 2 be visited (graciously) Ezek 38:8 ; Isa 24:22 , compare 29:6 ( ב accompare; see Di). 3 be visited upon , עַל person, Num 16:29 (subject מְּקֻדָּה ); יִמּ ׳בַּל רָ֑ע Prov 19:23 evil shall not be visited (that is, upon him; read perhaps עָלָיו שׂבֵר for יָלִין שָׂבֵעַ see Toy). 4 be appointed Neh 7:1 , + עַל 12:44 . Pi`el (intensive) muster a host, Participle מְפַקֵּד Isa 13:4 (of ׳י ). Pu`al be passed in review, Perfect 3masculine singular מֻּקַּד Exod 38:21 ; be caused to miss , deprived of, 1 singular מֻּקַּדְתִּי Isa 38:10 with accusative of thing, **sense dubious, Ges am (shall be) missed for ; Hi Di De Che Comm. am punished, mulcted of. Hithpa`el be mustered, Perfect 3plural הִתְמָּֽקְדוּ Judg 20:15 , 17 ; Imperfect 3masculine singular וַיִּתְמָּקֵד 21:9 ; 3 masculine plural 20:15 (on form see Ges § 54l ). Hothpa`al id. , Perfect 3plural הָתְמָּֽקְדוּ 1Kin 20:27 ; Num 1:47 ; 2:33 ; 26:62 (Ges l.c .). Hiph`il 29 Perfect 3masculine singular הִפְקִיד Gen 39:5 +, 2 masculine singular suffix הִפְקַדְתּוֺ 1Sam 29:4 , etc.; Imperfect 3masculine singular יַפְקִיד Isa 10:28 , etc.; Imperative masculine singular הַפְקֵד Num 1:50 ; Psa 109:6 , etc.; — 1 with accusative of person, set ( over ), make overseer ; 2Kin 25:23 ; + עַל Gen 39:4 ; Jer 1:10 ; Num 1:50 8 t., figurative, acc, of punishment, Lev 26:16 ; + ב Jer 40:5 3 t.; + ב and על Gen 39:5 ; + ל 1Kin 11:28 ; + שָׁם אֲשֶׁר 1Sam 29:4 where thou hast stationed him , insert also 29:10 ᵐ5 The We Dr and others; + אִתּוֺ Jer 40:7 , compare 41:10 . 2 with accusative of thing (implicit), a. commit, entrust (compare מִּקָּדוֺן ), פ ׳עַליַֿד 1Kin 14:27 2Chr 12:10 ; with accusative רוּחִי + בְּיָָֽדְךָ Psa 31:6 . b. deposit , with accusative of thing + ב location Jer 36:20 , + ל location Isa 10:28 ; accusative of person (Jeremiah as prisoner) + ב location Jer 37:21 . Hoph`al 1. be visited in punishment, Perfect 3masculine singular הָפְקַד Jer 6:6 (impersonal; but ᵐ5 ψευδής read הַשֶּׁקֶר JDMich, הַמֶּרֶק Gie). 2 be deposited , אִתּוֺ Leviticus 5:23 (subject הַמִּקָּדוֺן ). 3 be made overseer, Participle (הַ)מֻפְקָדִים , with בֵּית 2Kin 22:9 ; 12:12 Qr (Kt הפקדים ); י ׳בְּבֵית 22:5 (Qr strike out ב ), 2Chr 34:10 ; with עַל person 34:12 ; absolute 34:17 .
